verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs show a broad REST API (tasks, webhooks, rules, app components, status updates) and an MCP server, indicating substantial API coverage of UI functionality, but there's no explicit claim or evidence that 100% of UI actions (e.g. AI Studio automations, Dash AI Chief of Staff, or newer AI Teammate features) are exposed via API, and the openapi.json/swagger probes 404 suggesting no discoverable formal spec confirming full parity. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API access to AI Studio/Dash/AI Teammate features, working OpenAPI spec.
